description: Get the full schema for one petal_components component: attrs, slots, defaults, allowed values, and a working HEEx usage example. Call this every time you are about to write a tag like <.button>, <.modal>, <.table>, or <.field> so the attrs and slots match the real library instead of training-data guesses.

name.description: Component function name without the leading dot (e.g. 'button', 'modal', 'field', 'text_input'). The HEEx tag is the same name prefixed with a dot: <.button>. Call list_components for the full inventory.

name: get_component
